create_scene_with_camera_and_marker: create a Scene object and add a camera and marker to the world frame
add_frame_to_scene: add a new coordinate frame with a given SE3 pose to the scene
update_pose_estimations: estimate relative poses between frames using detected markers and a factor graph
calibrate_extrinsics: calibrate extrinsics between cameras and markers using multiple snapshots and factor graph optimization
visualize_scene: visualize the scene with markers, cameras, and frame axes using SceneViz
